positive_cases.prompt: 同一患者可有多个病灶，计算诊断准确性和区间并审计患者级聚类。
两个冻结的生存模型在同一独立外部队列上有删失结局，审阅用 DeLong 比较 C-index 并在外部重做 LRT 的计划。
required_checks: no ordinary ROC DeLong for censored C-index
no development LRT on frozen external predictions

positive_cases.prompt: 比较影像和临床模型的外部预测增益，目前没有具体临床动作和阈值，是否必须做 DCA 并优先连续 NRI？
required_checks: calibration and overall error remain distinct

positive_cases.prompt: 两扫描仪重复 ADC 测量具有患者与读者交叉结构及异方差，高 ICC 是否足以确认绝对一致性？
用不同医院分期上线 AI 的观测资料估计等待时间和患者结局变化，不能直接用上线前后显著性认定因果。
用症状触发的重复 CT 预测进展，纳入要求第二次扫描，且死亡阻止后续进展观察，审阅时间零和模型。
为同一研究含多个终点和时间窗的随机效应 meta-analysis 建立可执行统计 brief。
审阅诊断准确性综述是否应使用 bivariate/HSROC，而不是分别合并 sensitivity 和 specificity。
规划 prevalence、cumulative incidence 与 incidence rate 的统计综合，保留分母、人时和周期。
已提供可兼容 HR、OR 或 RR effect rows，请按各自效应量在 log scale 合并并保留 adjusted class。
审阅 ICC、weighted kappa、Dice 和 Bland-Altman evidence 是否被错误当成一种 agreement 指标合并。
解释外部验证研究中 AUC、calibration slope、O:E 和 Brier 的综合结果，不把 AUC 当成 calibration。
少量且异质研究的 meta-analysis 如何写 heterogeneity、prediction interval、funnel asymmetry 和 publication-bias 限制。
规划 donor-derived organoid 连续端点的 mixed model 和 power，不能把 wells 当 donors。
动物实验二元端点按 litter/cage 分配，建立 cluster-aware model 与样本量输入。
审阅重复计数端点是否需要 exposure offset、overdispersion 和 Poisson/negative-binomial mixed model。
解释 group-by-time mixed model，不用每个时间点独立检验替代纵向 estimand。
把 attrition、assay failure、cluster loss 和 power sensitivity 写入 Methods 与限制，不把 inflation 当偏倚修复。
研究者只给了 cells 数量，没有 donor、随机分配单位、方差、ICC 或 effect-worth-detecting，却要求最终样本量。
指导学员在研究很少、效应相关且资源有限时选择最低可辩护、标准和增强 meta-analysis 方案。
required_checks: fallback closure evidence and surviving claim

boundary_cases.prompt: 决定哪些研究符合资格以及是否临床上可合并。
选择 target engagement、rescue 和湿实验对照。
决定哪些参数、算法和 benchmark comparator 科学上必须比较。
绘制 forest、HSROC、calibration 和 power 曲线。
按目标期刊统计报告清单逐项核查页码。
根据冻结统计结果撰写整篇 Results 和 Discussion。

invariants: A statistical plan or brief is never labelled COMPUTED
The estimand and independent or allocation unit precede model selection
Patients, donors, litters, cages, animals, clusters, readers, wells, fields, cells, spots, folds, and seeds retain distinct roles
Dependent effects, shared comparators, readers, thresholds, and overlapping cohorts are not treated as independent studies
Random effects do not justify pooling incompatible estimands
Sensitivity and specificity remain paired in bivariate or HSROC diagnostic meta-analysis when their threshold relationship matters
Prevalence, cumulative incidence, and incidence rates retain denominator or person-time and period
HR, OR, RR, rate ratio, and mean differences are not interchangeable
ICC model type form, kappa weighting, correlation, agreement, overlap, and limits of agreement remain distinct
Prediction discrimination, calibration, overall accuracy, and clinical utility remain distinct
Heterogeneity and publication-bias procedures disclose weak information and cannot certify homogeneity or absence of bias
Continuous, binary, and count endpoints use estimand-matched models
Repeated measures and group-by-time contrasts preserve within-unit dependence
Attrition inflation does not repair attrition bias
Power inputs include effect worth detecting or precision, nuisance parameters, allocation, dependence, multiplicity, attrition, and feasibility
No universal EPV, event-count, sample, donor, litter, cage, animal, cluster, reader, or replicate threshold is used
Unknown covariance, ICC, variance, event rate, attrition, or power inputs are never invented
BIOSTATISTICIAN_REQUIRED stops a final model or sample-size recommendation until the named blocker is resolved
Mentor routes state prerequisites, resources, failure signals, fallback, closure evidence, and surviving claims without guessing inputs
Incremental inference distinguishes apparent nested fits, out-of-fold predictions, and frozen independent evaluation
Ordinary ROC DeLong is not used for censored C-index differences and a development LRT is not repeated on frozen external predictions
DCA requires a defined decision contract and continuous NRI is not a default requirement
Quantitative measurement, causal clinical impact, and longitudinal multistate routes each retain their own estimand and uncertainty assumptions
